description: Agent Education: submit an education-issued certificate, such as a program completion or professional certificate from a school or training provider, with the issuer’s record as provided: the certificate with its issuer, holder, program, number, issue and expiry dates and hours as printed; the issuer’s record with its issuer, holder, program, number, issue and expiry dates, hours and status (active, expired, suspended, revoked or not issued). The signed report gives the certificate and the issuer’s record, the holder, program and number on each side read as matching or differing, the issue date and the expiry on each side with the expiry read as matching, later, earlier, unprinted or unrecorded, the hours on each side and the status recorded, and counts them, and names a mismatched certificate: an issuer’s record showing it expired, suspended, revoked or not issued, a holder, program or number unlike the record and an expiry printed later than the record; then an issue date unlike the record, an earlier expiry, an expiry the certificate leaves off, other hours and an issuer named otherwise, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A record with no status, a holder, program or number missing on either side, or an expiry the record does not state leaves the certificate unverified. An expiry before the issue date is refused. Certificate numbers match by their letters and digits. This reads an education-issued certificate against the issuer’s record only: wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS for DiligenceOps; wever_license-evidence-check reads software license texts and wever_dataset-license-check reads dataset licenses against an intended use; wever_onboarding-credential-check reads credentials issued to a new agent and wever_credential-requirements-check reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements; wever_insurance-certificate-check reads a certificate of insurance against its policy; and wever_single-credential-issue issues a human single-status credential under its own product. Verdict edu_credential_mismatched, edu_credential_partial, edu_credential_unverified or edu_credential_aligned. POST /api/edu-credential-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.
